Title: Genji Balance Patch
Subtitle: Balance Update
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: Abathur ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue in which Networked Carapace provided a lower than intended Shield amount.
  • Secondary Shields granted by Networked Carapace will no longer benefit from Sustained Carapace.

=== Heroes: Anub'arak ===
[Updates]
  • Locust Swarm (R)
    • Damage reduced from 55 to 50
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Nerubian Armor (Passive)
      • Cooldown increased from 8 to 12 seconds
  • Level 4
    • Bed of Barbs (Q)
      • Damage decreased from 23 to 21
  • Level 7
    • Chitinous Plating (W)
      • Cooldown reduction increased from .75 to 1 second

=== Heroes: Auriel ===
[Updates]
  Abilities:
  • Bestow Hope (D)
    • Hope generation from damage dealt to non-Heroes reduced from 8 to 5%

=== Heroes: Azmodan ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Issuing a Move Command during All Shall Burn's wind-up time will no longer cancel the Ability cast.

=== Heroes: Cassia ===
[Updates]
  Abilities:
  • Ball Lightning (R)
    • Damage reduced from 200 to 180
  • Valkyrie (R)
    • Damage increased from 190 to 225
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Charged Strikes (Active)
      • Damage bonus reduced from 25 to 20%

=== Heroes: Gazlowe ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue preventing Rock It! Turrets from being self-cast or placed beneath unit and Hero models.

=== Heroes: Genji ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 4
    • Dragon Claw (Passive)
      • Damage activation requirement reduced from 415 to 375
  • Level 7
    • Cyber Shield (D)
      • Spell Armor duration increased from 2 to 2.5 seconds
    • Dodge (Passive)
      • Cooldown increased from 5 to 8 seconds

=== Heroes: Illidan ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Unending Hatred (Passive)
      • Increased the amount of Basic Attack damage gained from killing Minions from .1 to .2

=== Heroes: Kerrigan ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Bladed Momentum will no longer grant cooldown reduction for secondary targets hit by Basic Attacks after learning Fury of the Storm.

=== Heroes: Leoric ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue in which Renewed Swing dealt more damage than intended.
